title: Aftermath
start: Talk to Adrasteia in her library on the floor 2 of the White Knights' Castle in Falador, near the interrogation room.

recommended.t: Ring of respawn, passage of the abyss, Falador Teleport, activated Falador lodestone, or master archaeologist's outfit for quick access to the White Knights' Castle
Archaeology journal or master archaeologist's outfit to teleport to Kharid-et Dig Site
Activated Port Sarim lodestone or master archaeologist's outfit to teleport to Armadyl's Tower

kills.t: Various enemies within the The Zamorakian Undercity (if not already done at least once)
Zamorak, Lord of Chaos (level 14,000) (if not already beaten at least once)

steps.t: Talk to Adrasteia in the library on the floor 2 of White Knights' Castle in Falador. [Chat: Accept]
Enter Senntisten through the ancient door at the Varrock Dig Site.
Once inside, enter the Zamorakian Undercity by using the nearby pulley lift (a few steps east of the larger-looking pulley used to enter and exit Senntisten). [Chat: 2 Story mode]
Talk to Sir Cadian close to the entry.
Clear the Zamorakian Undercity on any difficulty.

sub.t: Players who have already cleared it may skip this step.

steps.t: Talk to Adrasteia in the library on the floor 2. She is not in the throne room.
Go to the throne room on the floor 3 and talk to Saradomin. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to anyone again to continue the dialogue. [Chat: Any]
Travel to the Kharid-et Dig Site and talk to Dr Nabanik. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Nex, Trindine, Wahisietel, or Azzanadra.
Talk to Armadyl in his tower south of Falador.
Talk to Adrasteia in the library on the floor 2, not the one in the throne room. [Chat: Any]
